اضطهدوا (form VIII)
# اِضْطَهَدُوا (iḍṭahadū) /idˤ.tˤa.ha.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# اُضْطُهِدُوا (uḍṭuhidū) /udˤ.tˤu.hi.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# اِضْطَهِدُوا (iḍṭahidū) /idˤ.tˤa.hi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
